intro.en: Formal ways to concede a point, however much, and the doubled subjunctive of whatever happens.

quieras o no.en: whether you like it or not

texto.en:
Formal partners of pero and aunque: **no obstante**, **con todo**, **aun así** begin a new sentence; **pese a** takes a noun or an infinitive; **pese a que**, **si bien** and **aun cuando** take a clause.

However much:

- **por más que** / **por mucho que** + verb
- **por mucho, mucha, muchos, muchas** + noun + **que**
- **por muy** + adjective or adverb + **que**

The mood works as with aunque. A fact takes the indicative: por más que **estudio**, no apruebo. Something open, or brushed aside, takes the subjunctive: por mucho que **insistas**, no iré; por muy caro que **sea**.

The doubled subjunctive means whatever, wherever, however: **digan lo que digan**, **pase lo que pase**, **vayas donde vayas**, **sea como sea**, **quieras o no**.

**Aun** without an accent is even. **Aún** with one is still.

filas: Por más que lo intento, no puedo.
Por mucho que insistas, no iré.
Por muy caro que sea, lo compraré.
Digan lo que digan, tengo razón.

frases.es: Por más que estudio, no consigo aprobar el examen de conducir.
frases.en: However much I study, I can't manage to pass my driving test.

frases.es: Por muy difícil que sea, lo aprobarás.
frases.en: However hard it is, you'll pass it.

frases.es: Mi padre dice que lo deje. No obstante, voy a seguir.
frases.en: My father says I should give it up. Nevertheless, I'm going to carry on.

frases.es: Haces bien. Digan lo que digan, tú sigue.
frases.en: Good for you. Whatever they say, you keep going.

frases.es: Pese a los nervios, la última vez casi apruebo.
frases.en: Despite the nerves, last time I almost passed.

frases.es: Pues pase lo que pase, lo celebramos.

pregunta.en: Complete: however much you insist, I won't go.

insistas.en: It is open, or brushed aside: subjunctive.

insistes.en: The indicative would state that you are insisting now.

insistir.en: After que you need a conjugated verb.

pregunta.en: Complete: however expensive it is, I'll buy it.

mucho.en: Mucho goes with verbs and nouns.

tan.en: Tan … que is for results, not concessions.

Pase.en: The same verb twice, both in the subjunctive.

pregunta.en: Which is the most formal partner of «pero»?

bloques.frase: Quieras o no, tienes que ir.

texto.en: Whether you like it or not, you have to go.
If you want, you can go.

explicacion.en: That would be si quieres, puedes ir.

texto.en: You don't want to go, do you?

bloques.frase: Por más que lo intento, no puedo

traduccion.en: However hard I try, I can't.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write about something you have never managed to do in spite of all your efforts, and something you will do whatever it costs.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Defend aloud an unpopular opinion, conceding points and holding your position.
